name: Hilkiah
bio:
Hilkiah was the high priest during King Josiah's reign. When Josiah sent Shaphan the scribe to the temple to oversee repair funds, Hilkiah told him, "I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD," and gave it to him. Shaphan read it to Josiah, whose torn-clothes reaction to its contents set off the inquiry that led to Huldah the prophetess. Josiah sent Hilkiah, along with Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asahiah, to consult Huldah about the book's dire warnings (2 Kings 22:8-14).

## 📖 Core Story: Purging the Temple

As Josiah carried out his sweeping reforms, he commanded Hilkiah, along with the priests of the second order and the temple doorkeepers, to remove and burn all the vessels made for Baal, Asherah, and the host of heaven from the temple (2 Kings 23:4).
